hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231869 (notice 'No hookups available') + RIDB catalog (all 19 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water/Sewer Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: All back-in gravel spurs. The catalog gives a length for only 2 sites (45 ft); the Forest Service posts a 45-ft maximum.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/mount-princeton-campground ('Mount Princeton Campground offers 19 sites'; 'Maximum RV length is 45 feet'; 'Parking spurs are gravel') + RIDB catalog (19 sites, Driveway Entry all Back-In, Max Vehicle Length 45 on 2 sites, blank on 17), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Wheelchair-accessible vault toilets; firewood sold on site. Water, trash or the host may be missing early and late in the season.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/mount-princeton-campground ('Wheelchair accessible vault toilets are provided'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'Services such as water, trash or a host may not be available during early and late season'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: May to September per the Forest Service, opening and closing weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/mount-princeton-campground ('Seasons of Use: May to September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Sites 1 and 14-17 are walk-up only, and site 2 is the host's until Labor Day weekend, then walk-up; the other 13 are reservable at least four days ahead, up to 6 months out. Walk-ups are exempt from the weekend (Fri+Sat) and 3-night holiday minimums. Reservable 'Peak Season' 2027: May 21 - September 18 (2026: May 22 - September 19); the week before is first-come only. Walk-up sites must be occupied the night paid; normally full from Friday, sometimes Thursday.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/mount-princeton-campground ('Sites 1 and 14-17 are walk-up ... All other sites are reservable'; 'Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231869 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'Reservations can be made 6 months in advanced') + /rates (Peak Season 2027-05-21 to 2027-09-18; First-come, First-served Season 2027-05-14 to 2027-05-20), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $25 a site on recreation.gov's 2026 and 2027 tables and the Forest Service page; two vehicles or one RV included, $10 a third vehicle. Senior/Access pass 50% off the holder's site.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231869/rates (Peak STANDARD/RV NONELECTRIC 25, 2026 and 2027) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/mount-princeton-campground ('$25 fee per site for overnight camping ... $10 fee for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-27

note: Salida RD (Pike-San Isabel NF) campground at 8,600 ft in Chalk Creek Canyon under ponderosa pine and Douglas fir; Chalk Creek can be reached from the campground. Mount Princeton Hot Springs is 4 mi away. No phone service at the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + rates + per-site catalog + FS page: confirmed 19 sites, no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov, $25. Changed max rig 60 -> 45 (FS 'Maximum RV length is 45 feet'); added back-in only, vault toilets and water, season May-Sept, fcfs some_sites (5 walk-up sites + host site after Labor Day), 4-day cutoff, 180-day window, weekend 2 / holiday 3 minimums, 14-night max, reservation season. Note: dropped the 60-ft and reservable restatements.
flags: Phone: none stored. Salida Ranger District 719-539-3591 (FS page 'Contact Phone'). Suggest it; recreation.gov's (661) 702-1420 is the concessionaire's line.
Reservable vs first-come: 13 of 19 sites reservable (unlike Monarch Park); sites 1, 14-17 walk-up, site 2 host then walk-up.
Pin is ~85 m from the centroid of the 19 rec.gov site coordinates (38.71376,-106.22361) - fine.

Waterfront (stored creekside): on Esri imagery Chalk Creek's channel runs along the south edge of the campground, roughly 15-40 m below the southern row of site points (sites 1-11). Consistent with creekside; no lead.
Open: the forest's current Willow Fire Area Closure is on the Leadville RD, not here; closed now only for the season.
